label: ApeA system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a single-component ApeA locus represented by the DefenseFinder Gao_Ape__ApeA profile, encoding an oligomeric HEPN-domain antiviral ribonuclease whose activation can cleave host tRNAs within their anticodon loops and drive abortive bacteriophage infection.
observations: ApeA branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual ApeA proteins, ApeA HEPN RNase activity, the DefenseFinder Gao_Ape__ApeA HMM profile, source database rows naming a Gao_Ape model, Ec2ApeA deoxydinucleotide activation, unresolved Ec1ApeA activators, and other phage-defense systems.
